image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of a wooden maypole decorated with colorful ribbons and a spiral garland near the top. The pole is central, with red and patterned streamers radiating outwards towards the edges of the frame. In the foreground, partial views of people (likely dancers) holding the ribbons are visible, including a grey sleeve and a beige jacket. The background features bare tree branches against a blue sky, suggesting an outdoor park setting in early spring.
